name: PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat)
benefit: Health cover for listed beneficiary families, and for every citizen aged 70 or above regardless of income

rules.text: Eligible if the family is on the official beneficiary list, or if any member is aged 70 or above (regardless of income). Land ownership alone does not qualify

manual_checks: Check name on official beneficiary list
Age 70+ is verified through Aadhaar e-KYC when the card is made
application_steps: Check whether your family is on the official beneficiary list using the official PM-JAY site or a CSC.
If listed, visit an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk or a CSC with the documents they request.
